title: APTool
summary: Turn the CardputerZero into a Wi-Fi diagnostic access point (NAT or bridge)
description: APTool turns the CardputerZero into a Wi-Fi access point for network diagnostics, for example in a data center. Connect it to Ethernet (the built-in port or a USB-C gigabit adapter) and your laptop or phone joins the hotspot, either behind NAT (DHCP included) or in a transparent bridge to the wired network, optionally on a tagged VLAN. The screen shows uplink speed and duplex, IP and gateway ping, the LLDP neighbor (switch and port), the connected clients and more. Everything is operated with the built-in keyboard. The access point is stopped again when you leave the app (hold Esc for 2 seconds).
